mission.goal: Upgrade the existing Federation Omega operator with an exact, receipt-bound CIOS production control lane.
mission.workflow: Validate exact targets; read Cloud SQL recovery state; deploy a digest-pinned revision at zero traffic; verify the tagged semantic and idempotency canary; restore the baseline traffic map; re-canary recovery; promote only with immutable deployment, canary and rollback receipts.
mission.data: Provider resource metadata, exact traffic maps, source/image/revision bindings and synthetic canary events; secret values are used in memory and never returned.
mission.interface: Authenticated Federation Omega JSON actions over the existing Cloud Run operator service.
mission.stack: Node.js 20 standard library and Google Cloud REST APIs.
mission.environment: Local provider fakes during source admission; existing Federation Omega Cloud Run service after exact-main admission.
mission.governance: Formation-gated, exact-target, idempotent, zero-traffic-first and provider-readback-bound.
mission.failure: Fail closed on authentication, target, image digest, service identity, Cloud SQL, backup/PITR, traffic, receipt, semantic, replay or promotion-gate drift.
mission.testing: Twenty-eight Node contract/adapter/action tests plus syntax checks before full repository admission.
mission.deployment: Not self-certified live by source; the CIOS Production Lane workflow upgrades and verifies the operator at zero traffic before any CIOS mutation.
mission.continuity: GCS generation-match-zero receipts and deterministic Cloud Run revision names make deployment and recovery resumable without blind retries.

assumptions.runtime: Existing Federation Omega Cloud Run service identity
assumptions.storage: Existing private control bucket for immutable non-secret receipts
assumptions.authentication: Existing Secret Manager token or Google-signed OIDC for operator ingress; Cloud Run service identity for provider APIs
assumptions.deployment: Existing Cloud Build, Artifact Registry, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL and Secret Manager estate

components.backend: Federation Omega exact-action router and GoogleCloudAdapter
components.database: Cloud SQL control readback only; CIOS owns pooled PostgreSQL connections
components.storage: Immutable JSON control receipts with ifGenerationMatch=0
components.authentication: Secret Manager admin token or allowlisted Google OIDC; service identity for Cloud APIs

observability.correlation_ids: deploymentKey, canaryKey, source SHA, revision and receipt digest
observability.health_checks: operator /health, CIOS tagged /health and /ready, Cloud Run ready revision
observability.structured_logs: provider-safe action results with checkedAt timestamps
observability.audit_logs: Cloud Audit Logs plus immutable control receipts
observability.metrics_alerts: Cloud Run traffic and readiness, Cloud SQL recovery controls and canary outcomes

testing.unit: Exact payload, target, digest, promotion and allowlist validation
testing.integration: Action router to provider fakes and adapter request-body readback
testing.e2e_or_smoke: Mocked zero-traffic deployment and semantic/replay canary
testing.fixtures_mocks: Synthetic services, revisions, traffic maps, backups, secrets and receipts
testing.failure_first: Mutable images, target drift, closed promotion, secret disclosure, missing backup/PITR and receipt mismatch

delivery.file_tree: ops/federation_omega_operator with contracts, action router, Google adapter, client, tests and documentation
deploy_commands: Dispatch CIOS Production Lane from exact main with operator-upgrade or a full phase
rollback_commands: Route operator traffic to the captured previous revision; invoke ROLLBACK_CIOS_TRAFFIC for the exact CIOS deployment receipt
delivery.debugging: Inspect the contract code, immutable receipt and provider readback; never expose tokens or retry an uncertain mutation under a new key

watchman.health: All local operator gates green; live v4 deployment is separately evidence-bound
watchman.rollback: Previous operator revision and exact CIOS baseline traffic receipt

continuity.idempotency: Deterministic revision plus immutable deploymentKey/canaryKey receipt paths
continuity.checkpoints: Git SHA, image digest, operator revision, persistence readback, traffic fingerprint and action receipts
continuity.resume_conditions: Exact main SHA and trusted WIF/operator authentication are verified
continuity.stop_switch: CIOS_PROMOTION_ENABLED=false or absence of any required immutable receipt

semantic_verification: managed persistence and idempotent replay canary passed with provider fakes
open_constraints: Live operator remains provider-readback-bound until v4 is deployed
Live Cloud SQL recovery controls and restore evidence remain pending
Traffic promotion requires fresh exact receipts
